Capture 8da369c4bdd64fc8a5def7052083cc4d at 2026-11-28T11:14:10Z directly delivered the full UTF-8 text in one HTTP 200 response, from the title through the final indented “the Work.” and both trailing LF bytes. limitations: The finding covers the identified 1.3a plaintext. Applying the LPPL to an actual work requires authority over that work and a project-specific determination of the notice, version, files, and maintainer.

reasoning: LPPL 1.3a header lines 7–8 expressly permit everyone to distribute verbatim copies of “this license document” and prohibit modifying it. The grant comes from the header itself.
